**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] The user is interested in writing a channel-specific characteristics and operation guide for managing owned media.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested items to organize in the guide include a channel overview, content strategy, brand standards, posting schedule, engagement guidelines, metrics and analysis, team roles and responsibilities, and an emergency response plan.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The channel overview should include a brief description of the media channel, its purpose, and target audience.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The content strategy should provide guidelines for creating and distributing content that aligns with the brand's messaging and goals.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Brand standards should detail the visual and tone of voice guidelines to ensure consistent brand representation across all channels.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The posting schedule should include a calendar or schedule of when content should be posted and the type of content to be posted.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Engagement guidelines should cover best practices for responding to comments, messages, and other forms of engagement, as well as a process for handling negative comments or feedback.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Metrics and analysis should include a system for tracking and analyzing the performance of content on each channel, including metrics such as reach, engagement, and conversions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Team roles and responsibilities should provide a clear definition of the responsibilities of each team member involved in managing the channel.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] An emergency response plan should outline how to handle crisis situations or unexpected events that may affect media channels.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Noted that the list provided is not exhaustive and that the user may have other items specific to their brand and channels to include.
